verdict.rationale: Groq's docs say its API is OpenAI-compatible. Switching an existing OpenAI client to Groq only requires passing a Groq API key and changing the base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, and Groq documents a Chat Completions API. That lets an agent swap providers through configuration rather than provider-specific code. Missing for 10: the docs only claim the API is 'mostly compatible' without listing the unsupported parameters, and there is no independent hands-on report of a mid-workflow switch.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: To start using Groq with OpenAI's client libraries, pass your Groq API key to the api_key parameter and change the base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
We designed Groq API to be mostly compatible with OpenAI's client libraries, making it easy to configure your existing applications to run on Groq
Generating text with Groq's Chat Completions API enables you to have natural, conversational interactions with Groq's large language models.
